public_source.title: Narrow admissible tuples
public_source.evidence: The MIT source artifact contains the complete k=343 tuple with diameter 2340. MathBases describes its database as the narrowest known tuples for k=2..5000 and reports an update on 2026-07-14. The k=343 row remains unmarked as proven optimal in the source table.

limitations: The source lists the tuple as a record, but does not prove that diameter 2340 is optimal.
The public-record survey covers the MIT Prime Gaps artifact and MathBases metadata available on 2026-11-05; it is not an exhaustive survey of all unpublished or unindexed results.
The locally saved witness is identical to the tuple published by the MIT source artifact. Exact checking verifies feasibility and diameter, not global optimality.

verification.method: Run sota.py and validate its tuple with tasks/t099/check.py using exact integer arithmetic.
